title: Arrow keys move a marquee selection
goal: Draw a marquee and press an arrow key and nothing happens. The selection should move, a point at a time, and further with shift, so a region can be lined up exactly without redrawing it by hand. Moving the selection moves the region only, never the pixels or the layers under it.
notes: Reported by the user on 2026-09-07. Confirmed by reading Sources/Photonz/CanvasKeys.swift: the arrow keys have two branches, one for several picked layers at line 118 and one for a single picked layer at line 129, and there is no branch for a pixel selection at all, so with a marquee and no layer picked the keys fall through and nothing happens. The pieces to reuse are already there: Nudge.delta in PhotonzCore gives the step, including the coarse step and grid alignment, and the selection itself is the region the clipboard and fill paths already act on. Order matters when adding the branch, since a marquee can be live at the same time as a picked layer; decide which wins and say so, and note the existing comment explaining why the multi layer branch comes first. Related and worth reading first: a-marquee-selection-follows-the-pointer-and-neve, which removes snapping from marquee drags, so a nudged selection should not gain snapping either unless the grid nudge step is deliberately wanted here.
acceptance: With a marquee selection and no layer being dragged, an arrow key moves the selection by one point in that direction, and with shift by a larger step, matching the step a layer nudge uses
The pixels and layers under the selection do not move, and the document is unchanged apart from where the region sits
Holding an arrow repeats smoothly rather than needing a press per point
Moving the selection off the edge of the picture is handled deliberately: the audit says whether it clips, stops, or is allowed, and why
With a layer picked and no marquee, the arrows still nudge the layer exactly as they do now, and with several layers picked they still move the group
Nudging the selection is one undo step per press, or coalesces sensibly if held, and the audit says which
A test in PhotonzCore covers a selection nudged by one point and by a large step, written before the change
Audit written under queue/audits/ with a selection before and after a nudge, anything rough filed as a follow-up
